items.title: Charles McPherson interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 9, 2024 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: coming from a great musician like him, and a wonderful, wonderful saxophonist and wonderful composer

ctx.x: Yeah, that is beautiful. I mean it’s self-serving that I say that, but coming from a great musician like him, and a wonderful, wonderful saxophonist and wonderful composer, that was around during the really golden age. You know his age really was privy to all of the great musicians before Charlie Parker. These people were still around and still living, and he’s heard these people in person. It’s not abstract for his — what was he born, 19 what 29 or 28? I don’t know somewhere probably 1926, 27, whatever it is.…
You were indicating finding your audience for young musicians and reaching them. I want you to see if you can name this tune. Are you ready?
